translations.web: and changed his prison garments. Jehoiachin ate bread before him continually all the days of his life;
translations.bsb: So Jehoiachin changed out of his prison clothes, and he dined regularly at the king’s table for the rest of his life.
translations.kjv: And changed his prison garments: and he did eat bread continually before him all the days of his life.
